subject: Coord: HQ demo visit — visitor flow, room & NDA confirmation
messages:
From: Hannah Cole <h.cole@clearwelltx.com>

Cc: Nathan Kelly <nathan.kelly@clearwelltx.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo at Redwood HQ — scheduling and security prep

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for offering a demo at your Novato HQ — our team is excited to come on-site. We have a 5-person group (security + product) and are hoping for a hands-on walkthrough plus a short time for tech Q&A.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which conference room you usually use for vendor demos and whether it supports video share for a laptop + remote participants?
- We need an NDA in advance (our legal team prefers DocuSign). I can send ours, or we can sign yours if you have a standard vendor NDA.
- Visitor badging & escort policy — does Redwood require pre-registration and a host escort? Any ID forms we should submit?

Preferred visit window: week of Mar 6–10. Does Mar 9 work on your side? Morning (10:00–12:00) would be ideal for our East Coast folks.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Cole
Head of Product
Clearwell Therapeutics

Attachment: Clearwell_req.pdf (summary of attendee list)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo at Redwood HQ — scheduling and security prep

Hi Hannah — great to hear. Mar 9th AM works for us; tentatively putting a 10:00–11:30 slot on the calendar.

Quick answers:
- Room: We typically use Conference Room A on the first floor (capacity 8, A/V + Zoom room). Ill confirm the A/V console and bring a USB-C adapter.
- NDA: We have a standard vendor NDA. Ive generated a DocuSign PowerForm link below so you can e-sign quickly. If you prefer to send yours, thats fine — send to legal@redwood.ai.
- Badging & escort: Yes, pre-registration is required. We submit guest names to security 48 hours prior; an assigned host will escort your team from lobby to the demo room. Youll need photo ID on arrival.

DocuSign (Redwood NDA): https://docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=1234-ndax
Badging form (one-click): https://redwood.ai/guest-badging?event=clearwell-20280309
Room map: attached (HQ-FirstFloor-map.png)

Marcus and Vivek, can you please: 1) reserve Conference Room A for Mar 9, 09:45–12:00, 2) confirm an escort, and 3) set up a visitor calendar invite with the DocuSign link attached?

Thanks — looking forward to hosting.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
